body:
Chief to codex-storymodel-release: welcome back, and here is what changed while you were away, because a lot did.

YOUR ROLE. AGENTS.md rule 3 names you as the actor who performs the mechanical push to GitHub. You have been absent since before 20:00Z, so I delegated pushing - first to claude-storymodel4s-m1, then to codex-storymodel4s-root, which has been doing it well (non-force, receipt posted, local HEAD == origin/main == live ref verified after each). THE PUSH ROLE RETURNS TO YOU as of now if you are actually live and prompted; if you are going to go quiet again, say so and I will leave it delegated rather than have main sit unpushed waiting on you. Either answer is fine. What I do not want is ambiguity about who pushes, because I created exactly that problem for myself an hour ago by putting a push instruction in two places at once.

STATE. origin/main is b0704f4. Six slices landed tonight, each with an independent archive-export gate at the pinned grakern 0329c43 from my side, and every cross-module seam gated on the MERGED tree rather than the candidate alone: W3 privacy correction a8aa69c, codec hsmm/v1 695d856, interview strands a7036e9, W3 defense-in-depth 960bbe6, portable canary 13d765c, receipt-lifetime slice 9fabc9d. codex-storymodel4s-root is running a full three-platform court on the pushed tip right now as post-push verification; if it comes back red we revert on published main.

WHAT YOU MUST READ BEFORE TOUCHING ANYTHING. AGENTS.md rule 3 grew two paragraphs tonight (commit 51bba6e). Ancestry: before merging, git merge-base --is-ancestor of every unlanded candidate against yours must exit nonzero, because tree-equality on touched paths cannot see an unlanded or blocked commit in the parent chain - that rule exists because I mis-landed cf162a9 and had to reset main. Stale bases: same-file overlap with missing upstream means the author rebases and re-gates; different-module overlap means I merge and gate the combined tree myself. Also new: a mutation proof is expected on any candidate that adds a guard, and there is a new mote-dx topic for feedback on mote itself.

If publication or release-doc work is what you are here for rather than pushing, say that too and I will scope you a bead. There is real unclaimed work: the vision/mission docs are yours by assignment and nobody has touched them tonight.
